edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber II 4

source_text: Nisi cognoveris te, o pulchra inter mulieres, egredere et abi post vestigia gregum, et pasce haedos tuos. Cognitio sui via est ad Deum. Quae se nescit, inter haedos pascitur, non inter oves; a dextris non erit sed a sinistris. Pulchra inter mulieres: ecclesia inter synagogas, vel anima inter virtutes mundi.

pass_b_english: [[If you do not know yourself, O beautiful among women, go out and follow the tracks of the flocks, and pasture your goats >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:8]]. Knowledge of oneself is the way to God. She who does not know herself pastures among goats, not among sheep; she will not be on the right but on the left. Beautiful among women: the church among synagogues, or the soul among the world’s virtues.
